caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall cabinet with two doors, shown in a three-quarter view from below and the left side. The cabinet is colored in various shades of brown, illustrating the wood grain texture throughout its surfaces. The doors are attached with hinges that are visible on the right side, and each door has a keyhole and a decorative metal escutcheon. The lower part of the cabinet features a shelf with a curved and scalloped apron beneath it, and the underside of the shelf is also visible. The background is a plain off-white color, and there are no additional objects present in the drawing. The artist’s signature and a notation are inscribed in red in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Hanging Closet
